name: Master QR Code Generator – Easy QR Code for page,post ,product and custom
author: Sharabindu

sections.description:
Master QR Generator lets you generate static QR codes in WordPress Website. Customize colors, shapes, and content with ease. No coding required. Whether you need QR codes for every page, post, product , Custom URLs, text, emails, phone numbers, Wi-Fi access, vcard or custom content — this plugin makes it effortless.

🎨 Key Features:
Generate QR codes for Posts,Pages, products and Custom Post type

Support for URLs, text, email, phone, SMS, Wi-Fi, and more

Customize colors, sizes, and QR code shapes

Add logos or icons inside your QR codes

Display QR codes using shortcodes or Gutenberg blocks

Download QR codes as PNG

No coding skills required — perfect for marketers, business owners, bloggers, and developers

Try the Demo | Backend Demo | Premium version | Documents

📌 Why Use Master QR Generator?
Easily integrate scannable QR codes into your WordPress site to improve user experience, boost engagement, and connect offline media with your online content. Ideal for marketing campaigns, event promotions, product pages, and contactless experiences.

FEATURES

STYLISH QR CODES FOR WORDPRESS:By using DotScale design customization facility, you can create very beautiful and attractive QR codes for WordPress websites.

CUSTOM TEXT, NUMBER, CUSTOM LINK QR: QR codes can be created for information such as custom text, phone numbers and custom links

GOOGLE MAP QR CODE: Create Google Maps QR Codes to display your site’s location. Generate QR Codes on Google Maps with excellent compatibility by inputting longitude and latitude information.

WHATSAPP CHAT QR CODE Generate and display WhatsApp QR code on website by inputting WhatsApp number.

WIFI QR CODE: WiFi can be connected using QR and access can be shared. Generate and display WiFi QR codes with this plugin by inputting WIFI name, type and password

EMAIL ADDRESS QR CODE: You can easily share your email address through QR code. Use QR codes to share email addresses with your visitors and customers. Generate and share QR code by entering email address

PHONE NUMBER QR CODE:You can share your contact information with your customers through a phone QR code. Can call you by just scanning the QR code.Generate and share QR code by entering just Phone Number.

VCARD QR CODE: vCard QR code contains basic information such as name, contact information, phone number, address URL, etc. You can create a vCard QR code with this plugin and display it via shortcode

EXTRA FEATURES FOR PREMIUM

► ADD QR CODE EYE COLOR: Make QR code attractive using QR code eye color in premium version

► ADD QR CODE EYE BORDER COLOR: Make QR code attractive using QR code eye border color in premium version

► ADD QR CODE VERTICAL TIMING COLOR: Make QR code attractive using QR code Vertical Timing Color in premium version.

► ADD QR CODE HAORIZONTAL TIMING COLOR: Make QR code attractive using QR code Haorizontal Timing Color in premium version.

► ADD CENTER LOGO: The premium version allows you to place your website’s Brand logo/image in the center of the QR code.

► ADD BACKGROUND IMAGE: The premium version allows you to place your website’s Brand logo/image in the background of the QR code.

► BULK VCARD QR CODE GENERATOR: In the premium version you can create as many vCard QR codes as you want. vCard allows the sharing of basic information like name, contact information, job title, address, and website URL via QR code.

► ADD LOGO FOR DIFFERENT POST TYPES: You can set different logo based on post type. So you can manage the brand logo and increase brand value by QR code. Upload different images based on different post types and improve site quality. View Demo

► SHORTCODE WITH ATTRIBUTES:In the free version, you can Use QR code shortcode for one time. But in the premium version, you can use attributes for each shortcode You can design QR codes differently using the shortcode features, change content elements, and generate QR codes in bulk using the features. Read Docs.

► WORDPRESS WIDGET SUPPORTED: The premium plugin has powerful WordPress widget facilities for creating QR. You can easily create custom text, links, current page links, numbers, WhatsApp chat access, and tax code for email addresses using this widget. View Admin Demo.

► QR CODE GENERATE WITH ELEMENTOR: Elementor users can easily generate QR codes with the “Master QR” addon. Master QR addon is excellent for generating current page URLs, custom links, email addresses, phone numbers, wifi access, WhatsApp chat, and vCard QR code. View Elementor Preview.

► QR CODE BULK PRINT: Post type based QR codes can be easily printed from one page. In bulk print settings, you can choose a post type like ‘Product’, ‘Post’, ‘Page’, ‘Custom Post’ etc. for filtering. You will receive a printout as a PDF. Live Demo :

► DOWNLOAD QR CODES FROM ONE PAGE: This is a powerful advantage for the website owner. They can easily download QR images from one page. This option is available for post-type QR. Live Demo :

And many more things are waiting for you to discover

GET PRO VERSION

Elementor QR Code Generator

Privacy

This plugin does not connect to any third-party applications. It does not collect or store any user information. This plugin generates QR code images based only on URLs and your custom content. QR code images are not saved to any file

Feedback

Give any suggestions or feedback, thank you for using or trying our plugin. Please let us know about your experience and rate this plugin.

Credits

The QR Code generator library is included (based on EasyQRCodeJS written by Ray, EasyProject) and don’t need any dependencies.
sections.installation:
Follow these simple steps to install and start using Master QR Generator:

📥 Automatic Installation (Recommended)
Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.

Go to Plugins » Add New.

In the search bar, type Master QR Generator.

Click Install Now next to the plugin.

Once installed, click Activate.

📦 Manual Installation
Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress Plugin Directory.

Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.

Navigate to Plugins » Add New and click Upload Plugin.

Select the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.

After installation, click Activate Plugin.

🚀 Getting Started
After activation:

Go to Master QR Generator in your WordPress dashboard.

Choose your desired QR code type.

Customize the appearance.

Generate and download or embed your QR code using a shortcode.
sections.faq:
How do I create a QR code with this plugin?

After installing and activating the plugin, go to Master QR Generator in your WordPress dashboard. Choose the type of QR code you want to create, enter your content, customize the style, and click Generate QR Code. You can then download or embed it using a shortcode or block.

Can I customize the appearance of my QR codes?

Yes! You can easily adjust the size, color, background, and add a logo or icon in the center of your QR code. The plugin also supports different QR shapes and eye patterns.

How do I add a QR code to a page or post?

You can add QR codes using the provided shortcode or by implementing the auto display feature.

Can I download QR codes?

Yes, you can download your QR codes in PNG format directly.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. The generated QR codes are fully responsive and scannable on all mobile devices.

Is the QR code image stored somewhere inside WordPress?

No, QR codes are created instantly on the web page.

I don’t display the QR code on the Page, Is it Possible? Display in the post or only Product product

Yes, you can easily customize from the settings page, which post type you want to display, You can use the turn on/off button, and You have full control of the display
